style.backgroundSystem: packshots, annotation and spec screens sit on a seamless pure white field #FFFFFF or a technical paper-white card #F6F6F4; on-location screens keep real backcountry surfaces only, wet slate shore #6E7A80, sun-bleached sandstone #C08D67, deep pine-green pool water #23412F, mist-flat scree #8C9AA3; annotation graphics reuse one thin hairline leader-line system in #2F6FB3 with hollow rounded label slots; no studio set dressing, no curtain folds, no podium garden, no filled-in value text
style.direction: bright backcountry utility ecommerce, clean gear-and-water study
style.iconSystem: thin single-weight hollow line pictograms in #2F6FB3 with hairline leader lines and rounded label slots, no filled gradients, no pictogram mix
style.lightingSystem: daylight screens keep one single readable sun direction with a long soft shadow and 4800K-to-7000K ambient matched to weather; studio screens use an even high-key front-left softbox with a bounce fill and one thin skimming sweep from the side that opens mould lines, thread crests and braid weave; water is always refractive with a true meniscus, never a painted blue sheet; exactly one credible contact shadow under every resting part
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent bright backcountry utility ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of seamless white #FFFFFF, misty slate grey-blue #8C9AA3, deep pine-green water #23412F and one lake-blue accent #2F6FB3 on technical paper-white cards #F6F6F4; neutral daylight temperature with one readable sun direction outdoors and an even high-key front-left key plus a thin skimming sweep in studio; modern geometric sans-serif; thin hollow line pictograms with hairleader leader lines and rounded empty label slots; real rock, water and gear surfaces only, never studio set dressing; stable vertical product silhouette and scale across every screen; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no invented product parts or printed values.
noDrift: no inconsistent lighting or shadow direction
no invented product parts or printed values
style.presentationRules: the unit keeps the same vertical silhouette, cap stack and lanyard loop on every screen; scale never changes between packshot, scene and annotation; annotation and spec screens place the product off-centre with the copy column on the opposite side
style.surfaceSystem: wet slate shoreline shelf, sun-bleached sandstone slab, mossy submerged log, wind-scree granite under low cloud, matte technical paper-white card, seamless white ground; hard plastics and braided cord read as real material under skimming light, never as soft rubber or glossy candy
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif, one headline slot plus at most four short label slots per screen, all copy carried by placeholders so no source wording survives
